stemMd:
To preserve the collection without concealing its history ______ the conservators' main objective. They document each intervention so later researchers can distinguish original material from repairs.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The entire infinitive phrase To preserve the collection without concealing its history is the subject. It names one objective and takes the singular verb is.

distractorRationale.a: The infinitive phrase functions as a singular subject.
distractorRationale.b: The plural auxiliary does not agree with that subject.
distractorRationale.c: The plural verb conflicts with the singular infinitive phrase.
